kahawi-mvp/core.framework.session/RedisSessionStore

RedisSessionStore

class RedisSessionStore(pool: JedisPool, prefix: String = "session:") : SessionStore

Redis-backed SessionStore. Values are stored in a Redis hash named session:{sessionId}.

This implementation serializes non-string values using Java serialization + Base64. Strings are stored as-is with an "S:" prefix. Serialized objects use a "J:" prefix.

Note: for production use, prefer a typed serializer (kotlinx.serialization or JSON) and set TTLs for session keys.
